pull: GET /api/v1/shop Bearer → validate → replace exact (store_id, unicid)
push: signed inbound shop_cache POST validates and replaces the same record without calling CP
display_allowed: validated fresh snapshot, or last-known validated snapshot within 6h after expires_at and only when the current refresh attempt failed TRANSIENTLY

failure_taxonomy.TRANSIENT: connection/timeout/transport/408/429/5xx → preserve known-good state, presentation may use eligible LKG, submission fails closed, no purge, no security fence
failure_taxonomy.AUTHORITATIVE_SECURITY: 401/auth failure/explicit revocation/proven wrong identity/canonical authoritative forbidden-deleted-gone → fail closed, never LKG, purge exact scoped cache+token
failure_taxonomy.CONTRACT_INVALID: 422/malformed JSON/malformed envelope/invalid schema/invalid payload/missing authoritative fields → current attempt fails closed, no same-attempt LKG, rejected payload never replaces known-good, token/credentials unchanged, no purge

status_classification.403_404_410: AUTHORITATIVE_SECURITY only with trusted canonical authoritative evidence, otherwise CONTRACT_INVALID

cleanup_rule: ordinary cleanup deletes only when expires_at < now - 21600; exact usable_until is retained

single_flight.lock_name: mtuc_sr_ + sha256(store_id + '|' + unicid) truncated to 64 chars (no raw UNICID)
single_flight.owners: at most one remote GET /shop per scope per refresh burst
single_flight.contenders: never call CP; eligible presentation LKG returned immediately, otherwise bounded wait + re-read
